# Result reference

Fields of the result objects. Array shapes are expressed in terms of k eigenstates, n Floquet states, D Fock states,
K static basis states and 2M'+1 stored harmonics. The descriptions are the field docstrings
in the source.

## QP eigenstates

`qdjj_solver.qp_solver.Eigenstates` (source: `src/qdjj_solver/qp_solver/solver.py`)

| Field | Type | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `energies` | `np.ndarray` | Eigenenergies, shape (k,), in the units of the Hamiltonian. |
| `vectors` | `np.ndarray` | Eigenvectors in the Fock basis, shape (D, k); state i is the column `vectors[:, i]`. |
| `residuals` | `np.ndarray` | Projected residual norms, shape (k,), in energy units. |
| `basis` | `FockBasis` | The `FockBasis` that defines the row order of `vectors` and the canonical occupations. |
| `qp_weights` | `np.ndarray` | Shape (k, q+1); `qp_weights[i, n]` is the probability of n bath quasiparticles in state i. |
| `observables` | `dict[str, np.ndarray]` | Expectation values of the requested named model observables, each of shape (k,); all are measured by default. |
| `timings` | `dict[str, float]` | Elapsed times of the calculation stages, in seconds. |
| `metadata` | `dict` | Numerical settings, sector, Hilbert-space restrictions and convergence diagnostics. |
| `hamiltonian` | `Hamiltonian \| None` | The `Hamiltonian` that was solved. |

## DMRG eigenstates

`qdjj_solver.dmrg_solver.Eigenstates` (source: `src/qdjj_solver/dmrg_solver/solver.py`)

| Field | Type | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `energies` | `np.ndarray` | Eigenenergies, shape (k,), in the units of the Hamiltonian. |
| `states` | `list` | The k eigenstates as TeNPy MPS. |
| `residuals` | `np.ndarray \| None` | Physical residual norms, shape (k,), in energy units; `None` if residuals were disabled. |
| `observables` | `dict[str, np.ndarray]` | Expectation values of the measured observables, each of shape (k,). |
| `timings` | `dict[str, float]` | Elapsed times of the calculation stages, in seconds. |
| `metadata` | `dict` | Numerical settings, sector, convergence diagnostics and sweep statistics. |
| `hamiltonian` | `Hamiltonian` | The `Hamiltonian` that was solved. |
| `prepared` | `object` | Canonical basis, conserved quantum numbers, and MPS mode ordering and grouping. |

## Floquet states

`qdjj_solver.qp_solver.FloquetStates` (source: `src/qdjj_solver/qp_solver/floquet.py`)

| Field | Type | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `method` | `str` | Solver that produced the states: `"sambe"`, `"propagator"` or `"rwa"`. |
| `representation` | `str` | `"fock"` or `"static"`: the basis of `modes`. |
| `omega` | `float` | Drive frequency. |
| `quasienergies` | `np.ndarray` | Quasienergies, shape (n,), on the chosen branch. |
| `folded` | `np.ndarray` | Quasienergies folded into the zone around `zone_center`, shape (n,). |
| `mean_energies` | `np.ndarray` | Replica-independent time-averaged energies eps - omega <m>, shape (n,). |
| `harmonic_indices` | `np.ndarray` | Harmonic indices m of the stored modes, shape (2M'+1,). |
| `modes` | `np.ndarray` | Mode harmonics, shape (2M'+1, d, n): u_m of state j is `modes[i, :, j]` with `harmonic_indices[i] == m`, in the basis given by `representation`. |
| `harmonic_weights` | `np.ndarray` | Harmonic weights, the squared norms of u_m, shape (n, 2M'+1). |
| `centroids` | `np.ndarray` | Harmonic centroids <m>, shape (n,). |
| `boundary_weights` | `np.ndarray` | Weight in the outermost harmonic blocks m = -M and M (Sambe) or outside the window -M <= m <= M (propagator); zero for the rotating-wave model; shape (n,). |
| `static_weights` | `np.ndarray` | Time-averaged weights of the static eigenstates a, the sum over m of the squared overlaps of a with u_m; shape (n, s), with s = `states` for the Fock basis and s = K for the static basis. |
| `labels` | `np.ndarray` | Index of the static state assigned to each Floquet state, shape (n,). |
| `residuals` | `np.ndarray` | Residual bound, shape (n,): the Sambe window residual combined with the leakage into the omitted harmonics, or the eigendecomposition residual of U(T) or of the rotating-wave matrix. |
| `basis` | `FockBasis` | The QP `FockBasis` of the sector. |
| `static` | `Eigenstates` | Static `Eigenstates` of the reference Hamiltonian `periodic.reference`. |
| `periodic` | `PeriodicHamiltonian` | The `PeriodicHamiltonian` that was solved. |
| `fock_residuals` | `np.ndarray \| None` | Fock-space residuals of static-basis results, shape (n,); `None` otherwise. |
| `effective_matrix` | `np.ndarray \| None` | Rotating-wave matrix of `rwa_model` results; `None` otherwise. |
| `timings` | `dict` | Elapsed times of the calculation stages, in seconds. |
| `metadata` | `dict` | Settings and diagnostics, for example window residuals, leakage and step errors. |

## Probe matrix elements

`qdjj_solver.FloquetTransitions` (source: `src/qdjj_solver/common/spectra.py`)

| Field | Type | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `omega` | `float` | Drive frequency. |
| `photons` | `np.ndarray` | Photon numbers q of the stored harmonics. |
| `elements` | `np.ndarray` | `elements[i, a, b]` is X^(q) for `photons[i]`, final state a and initial state b. |
| `bra_quasienergies` | `np.ndarray` | Quasienergies of the final (bra) states. |
| `ket_quasienergies` | `np.ndarray` | Quasienergies of the initial (ket) states. |
| `bra_labels` | `np.ndarray` | Static labels of the final states. |
| `ket_labels` | `np.ndarray` | Static labels of the initial states. |
| `bra_indices` | `np.ndarray` | Indices of the final states in their `FloquetStates`. |
| `ket_indices` | `np.ndarray` | Indices of the initial states in their `FloquetStates`. |
| `total` | `np.ndarray` | Time-averaged squared norm of X(t) applied to each initial state: the right-hand side of the sum rule. |
| `same_states` | `bool` | True when bra and ket come from the same `FloquetStates` object. |
| `complete` | `bool` | True when the bra states form the complete set of their representation. |
| `default_initial` | `int` | Initial state used by `lines()` without arguments: the dressed ground state of the ket sector, `dressed_state(0)`, or the first ket state if that state was not selected. |
| `probe` | `str` | Name of the probe. |
| `metadata` | `dict` | Probe harmonics, sectors, methods and the matrix-element convention. |

## Spectral lines

`qdjj_solver.SpectralLines` (source: `src/qdjj_solver/common/spectra.py`)

| Field | Type | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `frequencies` | `np.ndarray` | Sorted line frequencies; positive values correspond to absorption of a probe quantum. |
| `strengths` | `np.ndarray` | Line strengths, weighted by the initial populations. |
| `final` | `list` | Final-state indices merged into each line (a degenerate group). |
| `initial` | `list` | Initial-state indices that contribute to each line. |
| `photons` | `np.ndarray` | Photon number q of each line. |
| `elastic` | `np.ndarray` | True for elastic lines, between states of one degenerate group at q != 0. |
| `metadata` | `dict` | Probe, initial states, weights and merging options. |
